referenceSources.description:
A gray two-door Nissan Skyline R32 coupe is presented against a plain backdrop, showcasing its classic late-1980s design. The car’s smooth body panels, integrated rear spoiler, and five-spoke alloy wheels emphasize its sporty yet refined character. The clear headlight lenses and subtle side mirrors contribute to the clean, aerodynamic profile.

Introduced in 1989 under Nissan’s "901 Movement," the R32 Skyline offered both sedan and coupe variants with engines from 1.8L to 2.6L. The lineup included turbocharged and naturally aspirated inline-six engines, with the GTS-4 featuring ATTESA E-TS all-wheel drive. In the same year, the GT-R returned with the twin-turbo RB26DETT engine, spawning numerous limited editions like the GT-R NISMO and N1. The R32’s engineering and motorsport achievements have made it a landmark in automotive history.
